amendment_reason: V01 persisted zero corpus files and produced no evaluation result because rapid sequential single-page requests received HTTP 429. V02 persisted zero corpus files and produced no evaluation result because MediaWiki rejects revision-window parameters such as rvstart/rvlimit when multiple pages are supplied (invalidparammix). V03 preserves every V01 scientific parameter and uses the API-supported single-page request shape with a predeclared polite request interval and bounded 429 Retry-After/backoff handling.

projection.unit: eligible MediaWiki section with normalized body length >= 120 characters
projection.identity: title + canonical heading path, with the live current-core logical identity resolver allowed to abstain
projection.document_shape: heading paths + block count + unit order
projection.artifacts: one section artifact per logical unit + one document index + deterministic four-bucket topic projections

claim_boundary: Prospective scientific protocol inherited unchanged from V01, with only predeclared transport amendments after V01/V02 produced no persisted corpus and no performance/equivalence result. Evidence scope remains the current typed-change-channel Core on a deterministic Wikipedia section projection; it is not OCR, ontology, legal/regulatory, or customer-data evidence.
